name: Prank
metaDescription: Prank sound buttons: alarms, buzzers, static and fake phone sounds to catch your friends off guard. Instant play, free downloads.
intro:
Sounds engineered to get a reaction. The prank soundboard is stocked with alarms that stop conversations, buzzers that imply someone got an answer very wrong, fake phone sounds, and bursts of static that make people check their speakers.

Everything plays instantly from the browser, with no loading and no waiting, which matters more than you would think mid-prank, and everything downloads free as MP3 for the more elaborate setups. Use responsibly, or at least point the blame at whoever laughed hardest.

faq.a: The classics work because they trigger reflexes: a notification ping makes everyone check their phone, an alarm makes people look for the exit, and a wrong-answer buzzer ends any argument.

faq.q: Can I play these from my phone?
faq.a: Yes. Bleepboard is a website, so every button works in any phone browser with nothing to install.
